title: Thin and duplicate Spotlight pages are in the sitemap

source.ref: SEO, GEO and speed deep scan 2026-11-19 (production crawl of 3,000 URLs, all 720 sitemap pages, 8 crawler user agents, Lighthouse on 14 templates)

detail:
Some Spotlight pages in the sitemap have almost nothing on them (/spaces/awesome-possum/spotlight 14 words, /spotlight/aidentyack 17 words). /spotlight/<handle> and /spaces/<slug>/spotlight carry the same title for the same person. /spaces/hq is titled "Frequency · Frequency". 127 event titles run past 65 characters. 16 ended series pages stay indexable with no Event schema (by design, noted for the record). Wanted: a Spotlight with nothing on it stays out of the sitemap and says noindex, one of the two Spotlight addresses is canonical, and the root Space title says the name once.

A Spotlight whose About text (a member's bio, a Space's About) is under 12 words says noindex, follow and leaves the sitemap (lib/seo/thin-spotlight.ts; owner approved the sitemap reader test change 2026-11-20). A member Spotlight's title carries the handle, "Name (@handle)", so it no longer matches the Space Spotlight of the same name. The root Space title was already fixed by SCAN-1302. Long event titles and ended series pages are left as they are (noted for the record in the scan).

verify.note: Fails on main: no thin-Spotlight rule, both Spotlight pages are indexable whatever is on them, the sitemap lists every published Spotlight, and the member and Space Spotlights of one name share a title. Passes once a Spotlight under 12 words of About says noindex, follow and leaves the sitemap, and the member title carries the handle.
